blocking_issues: The exact original matched result panel and indispensable controls are not yet bound. The historical scope does not mandate every main/extended figure or all acquisition/preprocessing stages.
Immutable release, animal/session/schedule and behavior-versus-photometry identities, learner exclusions and source code/data/correction parity remain unresolved.
Any claimed full-range proportional-scaling result must preserve the source 3,600-second departure; narrower original results must state their limits.

Preserve source reward opportunities, timing and count/context controls. Reward-interval rather than cue/trial-interval specificity requires appropriate partial-reinforcement evidence; other control branches depend on the named claim.
Source dopamine onset uses a window tied to the behavioral learned trial (Methods Par58); lag is not a behavior-blind prediction and must retain that information access.
The published Figure 4b correction concerns raster alignment, not a new algorithmic performance baseline.

Raw-AIC/log-RSS and censoring details are retained code-supported findings, not a fresh MATLAB audit by this review. Original in-sample fit, iteration averaging and k=0 versus parameter-penalized outputs must remain distinct.
Authentic trajectories/responses/model operands, numerical references, independent computation, agreement criteria, uncertainty and same-primary superiority rules remain unresolved.
Larger effects, smaller p-values or lower model AIC alone do not establish improvement of the complete biological family.

No explicit reviewed Figure 5 replacement-primary authority was found in inspected definitions/reviews/handoffs. Existing provisional component acceptance does not authorize replacement or every-figure expansion.
Mixed biological-reproduction/model-fit-improvement admission remains unavailable when exact scope cannot be represented faithfully; all scientific outcomes remain unknown.

This standalone v2 declaration is a quantity-family specification only. It does not select the exact matched original primary contrast; required cohort/condition membership and claim-dependent controls remain unresolved before any admission.
